Name: Anti-Cheat Server
Author: funnysnek
Description:
When installed by the main player, this detects players with cheat mods installed and kicks them. Players receive a private message telling them which mods to remove:
[img]https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/230581/48118762-3e3e0580-e23b-11e8-850a-3eac6c7609b0.png[/img]

Farmhands don't need to install this mod.

[b][size=5]Install[/size][/b]
[list=1]
[*][url=https://smapi.io]Install the latest version of SMAPI[/url].
[*]Unzip the mod folder into [font=Courier New]Stardew Valley/Mods[/font].
[*]Run the game using SMAPI.
[/list]
You can optionally edit the mod's [font=Courier New]assets/mod-blacklist.json[/font] file to change which mods are blocked (see [url=https://raw.githubusercontent.com/funny-snek/anticheat-and-servercode/master/Server/assets/mod-blacklist.json]default blacklist[/url]).

[b][size=5]Compatibility[/size][/b]
Compatible with...[list]
[*]Stardew Valley 1.6.15 or later;
[*]Linux, macOS, and Windows;
[*]multiplayer when installed by the main player (does nothing in single-player).
[/list]
Pairs well with:[list]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2677]Always On Server[/url]﻿ lets you host a server 24 hours per day, without the host player at the computer.
[/list]
[b][size=5]See also[/size][/b]
[list]
[*][url=https://github.com/funny-snek/anticheat-and-servercode]Source code[/url]
[/list]
